༁ྃ:bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag lha srin dam bsgrag bka' nan rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag lha srin dam bsgrag bka' nan rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag lha srin dam bsgrags dka' nan rab brjid rdo rje'i ri dbang zhes bya ba/ bla ma khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtses mngon mtho rgyal sras kyi// dbang po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// mthu stobs rdo rje rtse brgya pas// lha dang lha min 'dul la 'dud// gang gi bka' nan rdo rje'i tshig /rdo rje'i ri dbang ltar brjid pa// lha srin rnams la bsgrag pa'i thabs// slar yang 'di na gsal bar bkod// de yang gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sde brgyad 'byung po rnams bka' 'bang rtsis su phab ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung zhing 'jig rten skyong bar bsgos pa ltar/ deng sang bstan pa nyams shing 'jig rten mi bde ba/ legs nyes go log pa'i skabs 'dir sngon gyi tha tshig bsgrag cing bstan 'gro bde ba'i phrin las bcol ba gal che zhing*/ bod yul 'dir glo bur lhags pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis lha srin 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byed pas de dag dam la bzhag cing*/ nag phyogs bsgral ba la nus pa thogs med du mnga' ba'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis bya ba la bzhi/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba/ phan yon sogs 'phros don no// dang po la gsum/ yo byad bsham pa/ rgyab rim sgrub pa/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs dus dang gza' skar bzang ba'i nyi ma la/ dben zhing sbas pa'i gnas sam ri'i rtse mkhar gyi yang thog sogs phyogs thams cad mthong zhing gnyan cing bkra shis pa'i gnas su/ bdag gi rnal 'byor gang la bsten pa'i rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i rten yod na rgyas par bkram/ sde brgyad 'byung po'i brngan rdzas kyi mdos sde brgyad srid pa'i spyi mdos ltar bsham/ gro lod lta bu'i zor gtor/

liṅga/ thun rdzas/ mtshon cha/ bsang brngan gser skyems kyi yo byad sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ gnyis pa rgyab rten rim gro tshogs gsag gi rim pa/ sgrol ma'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog /chu gtor brgya rtsa/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs rgyal ba'i gsung rab klog /sāts+tsha gdab/ srog bslu nye'u 'don pa rnams rang gis sgrub pa dang gzhan la byed du bcol/ gsum pa bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs na/ gtso bo las logs su khyad par 'phags pa bsgom pa ni/ hrī: skye ba med pa'i ye shes las: 'gag med snying rje'i rol pa ni: hrīḥyig dkar po 'od 'bar las: 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad sbyangs: stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: bdag nyid hrīḥlas skad cig gis: snang srid zil gnon pad+ma 'byung: khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar dmar mdangs: phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i: rdo rje rtse lngas lam ston cing: g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum pa: 'khar ba'i tshul gyis brten cing 'dzin: dbu la pad zhwa brjid par gsol: sku la gsang gos ber mthing dang: chos gos gsum gyis mdzes par bklubs: zhabs gnyis mchil l+h+wam dang bcas te: gshegs pa'i stabs kyis gdan la bzhengs: snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun: phyag rgyas 'debs pa'i sku ru gsal: khyad par 'phags pa kho na la brten na 'dir/ dbang bskur/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod/ dzap bskul rnams bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ gi sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang: rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs dang: chos skyong srung ma'i nus stobs kun: lha sngags phyag mtshan rnam par ni: nam mkha' gang ba bdag la thim: ye shes gzi byin cher 'bar zhing: dam can tshogs kun las la bkol: sde brgyad 'byung po gzir zhing gcun:

dam sri gdon bgegs thal bar brlags: dkar phyogs tshogs rnams bran du 'dus: khams gsum brtan g.yo'i snang cha kun: rig 'dzin bla ma'i phyag rgyar sad: grags stong rdo rje'i sngags sgra yis: mtha' yas zhing kun rgyas par gang: rtog tshogs rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang: mi g.yo dgongs pa'i dzap 'di bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bzlas ka dag dbyings su bzhag: res 'ga' rang 'dra'i ye shes sku: dpag med nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: lha 'dre mi gsum snying la thim: lcags la gser 'gyur rtsis thebs ltar: kun gyi shes rgyud dbang med du: byang chub sems gnyis ngo bor bsgyur: bdag la 'dud cing rab dad pas: thar pa'i lam la zhugs par bsam: rtsa sngags sham bur 'di bzlas bsnyen: sarba a nṛ tri tsit+ta hring hring dza dza: sdus sdus sarba lo ka bā shaṃ ku ru ho: res 'ga' kun la snying rje bskyed: res 'ga' stong nyid phyag rgyas gdab: de ltar rgyun du brtson pa yis: mi dang mi min thams cad kun: chos bzhin dbang du 'du ba dang: 'gro 'dul phrin las mtha' yas pa: pad+ma bdag dang mnyam par 'gyur: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs pa ltar dgongs pa bskyang*/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor kho na dang*/ gro lod kho nar bsten kyang bsnyen dmigs nges par dgos/ bdag gi rnal 'byor khyad par ba 'di/ gnas chen byin 'bebs/ sde brgyad kyi mdos/ lha srin dam bsgrag thams cad kyi gong gnon yin pas nges par skabs so sor bdag gi rnal 'byor du bya ba gnad che/ de nas tshogs dang skong bshags bsang brngan gser skyems rgyas par bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bcu las/ dang po gser skyems mchod pa sngon du song nas sa khongs gzung*/ gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las bdag: snang srid 'khor 'das zil gnon pa'i: rdo rje'i brtul zhugs grub pa yin: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs:

dam can srung mas phrin las sgrubs: sde brgyad 'byung po dam la 'dus: nag phyogs bgegs rigs phyir dengs shig: gsum pa nag phyogs bskrad pa ni/ sbyong chas byin gyis brlab pa sogs las byang 'bring po ltar byas/ gtor ma dang mar me bskor zhing*/ zhi ba/ phyed ma/ drag po'i sbyong ba ni khrus chog ltar bya/ bzhi pa khrus bya ba ni ri khrus ltar bya/ lnga pa sde brgyad snying nas drang zhing bkug pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi yab: nga ni sems can kun gyi srog: nga ni brtan g.yo kun la khyab: nga ni srid zhi'i spyi dpal yin: snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun: ye shes rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 'debs: tha tshig gnyan po'i bkar btags nas: thams cad thams cad bran du khol: tshur gshegs dam longs 'byung po'i tshogs: phyogs bcu dus bzhir khyab pa yi: ma mo mkha' 'gro sde brgyad tshogs: gum gum chum chum dam la 'dus: gal te 'du bar mi byed cing: bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na: yak+sha kro dhas snying khrag 'thung: de bas myur du 'dir 'dus shig: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba bhū ta sa ma ya tsit+ta dung dung hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ dza dza: sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: thugs nas spros pa'i 'od zer las: rigs bzhi'i ging chen grangs med pas: srid pa gsum gyi sde brgyad kun: dbang med mdun du bkug cing bcings: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan 'bangs su gyur: drug pa dam tshig bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po nas: tha ma da lta thug gi bar: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis: dam la bzhag pa'i lha 'dre kun: bstan 'gror phan bde sgrub pa yi: rdo rje'i tha tshig bro bor ba: dran nam lha yi dge bsnyen tshogs: dam tshig bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal bskyed nas: bka' las ma 'da' bod kyi yul: mtha' dbus med par srung ba dang:

sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du srings: rgyal khams thams cad bde ba dang: bkra shis dge mtshan phun tshogs mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba bhū ta ma hā pañtsa a mṛta badz+ra sa ma ya u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭha: bdun pa mdos gtor gyi brngan sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ mdos sngar byin gyis brlabs pa yin na mi dgos kyang*/ ma brlab pa sngags drug phyag drug gis byin brlabs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs gtor chen po: 'khor 'das 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: ma tshang med pa'i mkho dgu'i gter: rgya che rgyun mi 'chad par bsam: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas bsngo: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba bhū ta sa pa ri bā ra na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ bā lin+ta swā hā: hūm̐: srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod dgu'i mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: dpal gyi bka' las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i las kun myur du sgrubs: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i sngags rgyud dang: khri srong lde'u btsan lha rgyud kyis: bde bar bskyangs pa'i bod khams kun: rtag tu srung skyob phrin las mdzod: de ltar yang yang bskyar te bsngo: brgyad pa dam tshig rdo rjes gzir zhing chad mdo bsgrag pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ phyag mtshan rdo rje gdengs shing*/ las byang chad mdo lan gsum gyi mthar/ aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥsarba bhū ta badz+ra sa ma ya sma ra: sa ma ya ma ti kra ma: sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu: skabs 'dir sde brgyad so so'i sngags gcun dang shi sa bstan pa sogs ni rgyun du mi rung ngo*// dgu pa slar yang nan tan bka' bsgo ba'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ gser skyems khrag chang phud bdud rtsis bran pa mchod la/ hūm̐ bh+yo: nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: nga ni pad+ma he ru ka: srid zhi yongs kyi spyi dpal che: khyed rnams nga yi bran dang g.yog:

'bangs dang khol po yang g.yog yin: sngon chad ji ltar khas blangs bzhin: deng 'dir dran zhing bskul ba'i phyir: dam tshig rdo rje spyi bor bzhag: dam rdzas bdud rtsi lce la bstims: 'khor 'das gzhir bzhengs gtor mas bskangs: tha tshig gnyan po rna bar bsgrags: rdo rje'i sngags kyis gnad la phab: gangs can 'gro kun bde ba dang: bstan pa spel bar gnyer gtad pa'i: yal gam 'di las khyod ma 'da': g.yar dam 'di las khyod 'das na: snying gi dkyil na gnas pa yi: dam tshig bdud rtsi sems dpa' che: yak+sha kro dha'i skur bzhengs nas: snying khrag 'jib cing myur du gsod: rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'phen ta re: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bdag gis bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon: gal te mi nyan 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: drag por khros pa'i brtul zhugs kyis: ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom: nyi zla kun kyang tshogs por 'phen: gdon bgegs 'byung po dpung bcas kyi: bdun rgyud rigs kyang skad cig brlag: de bas dam la ma 'da' bar: rgyal khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: de ltar dam la bzhag pa yis: ji ltar bka' bstsal bgyid do zhes: zhi zhing gus pa'i sems kyis su: rdo rje'i tha tshig bro bor gyur: bcu pa nag phyogs bka' la mi nyan cing dam la 'khu ba rnams bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ gro lod kyi las mtha' dang zhal bstab kyi mthar/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri bā ra sarba duṣ+ṭān bigh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: sarba duṣ+ṭān ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas sha khrag rig 'dzin drag po sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pas hab dir gyis zos par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bzhi/ zor 'phang ba/ mdos gtor gshegs pa/ rjes bsdu/ dga' ston bya ba'o// dang po ni ling ro gtor mar bstab ste tshogs lhag ma btang*/ ling ro lhag ma'i nang du dmar gtor bzhag la sde brgyad kyis zos lhag nad mtshon dug gi rang bzhin du

bsam la/ gro lod kyi gtor zor dang 'brel na zor 'phen skabs 'phen zhing*/ ma 'brel na drag sngags 'chams stabs bcas gnod pa'i phyogs la 'phangs pas/ sde brgyad 'byung po bka' la mi nyan pa thams cad rjes shul lhag ma tsam yang med par brlag par bsam/ gnyis pa mdos gtor mchod pa rnams spyi mdos dang 'brel na zhi mdos gtang ba ltar dang*/ ma 'brel na rol mo dang bcas pas gtsang sar gshegs so// gsum pa rjes bsdu ni/ brtan skyong*/ bro brdung*/ dngos grub blang ba sogs rjes chog las gzhung ltar bya/ bzhi pa dga' ston ni/ de nyin khrom tshogs mang 'dus la: chas ldan rta rgyug go yang phyar: lha rgyal 'bod cing glu bro bya: bkra shis me tog rgya cher 'thor: zhes gsungs pa ltar ci 'byor bya 'o// bzhi pa phan yon sogs 'phros don ni/ zhi bas brngan dang drag pos gzir: shin tu drag pos tshar gcod pa'i: man ngag khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog: rdo rje'i bka' nan cho ga 'di: nus ldan gang gis brtsam pa na: bod khams spyi dang bye brag la: phan pa'i rten 'brel bla na med: nad yams 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi: char chu lo phyugs dpal g.yang rgyas: bsam pa 'grub cing 'dod dgu 'du: nag phyogs 'byung po tshar gcod cing: sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas: de phyir snying rje dam tshig can: pad+ma bdag gi brgyud 'dzin rnams: gzhan don 'gro 'dul thabs chen po: 'di nyid kho nar brtson par bya: sa ma ya: zhes gsungs so// bsdu na mdos ma grub kyang dpal gtor sde brgyad bshos bus bskor bas rung bar gsungs kyang brngan rdzas mdos ni rgya chen por byed pa legs so// 'di byed pa po'i gang zag gu ru'i lung gis bsngags pa'i rgyal tshab lta bu dang*/ de'i gdung rigs nus ldan mkhyen rtogs ldan pas bya ba las gzhan phal gyi spyod yul ma yin no// sde brgyad spyi mdos gro lod kyi gtor zlog sogs la 'brel na legs cha che/

dam tshig phyag rgya'i nyi 'od kyis// tha tshig pad+ma'i tshogs bzhad nas// phan bde'i zil dngar phyogs brgyar spro// bstan 'gro'i gsos kyi rgyu ru shog /ces pa mchog gyur gling pas gter gzhung las khol du phyung zhing man ngag gis gsal bar byas te bkod pa'o/// /
